name: vstack
description: Cavalry Visual Stack — visual-first delivery for Claude Code: plan, design, and build software on artifacts you operate, not documents you read. Skills are invoked as /vstack:<skill>. Currently: init (start a project from the Cavalry template with a stack + add-on chooser), wireframe (build a UI wireframe and comment directly on it), user-story-map (plan releases on an interactive drag-and-drop story map), and phase-wireframe (see a signed-off mockup at each release phase). The interactive ones link the open page back to the Claude session, so edits and feedback return without copy-paste.
